newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK MAGISTRATE HEARS MORE TESTIMONY ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK MAGISTRATE HEARS MORE TESTIMONY ON BOURSE.

text.p: Investigating magistrate Costas Ganiatsos heard additional testimony on Thursday by the bourse clear house general manager and the operations supervisor, court sources said.
Ganiatsos who visited the Athens stock exchange on Wednesday had requested supplementary information on operations after the Delta Securities scandal.
He will continue to call witnesses during the investigation.

Court sources told Reuters that Delta Securities had been visited by the financial crimes division (YPEDA) and auditors even before its 2.6 billion drachma default which shook the bourse. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
